removed.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to broadband electromagnetic disturbances and narrowband electromagnetic disturbances if the levels measured do not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, paragraphs 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2. for vehicles and paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.10.2.1. for ESAs (as appropriate).

removed.text: When the conformity of a vehicle, component or ESA taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to electromagnetic radiation if the vehicle ESA does not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when the vehicle is in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and is subjected to a field strength, expressed in Volts/m, up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1., and, if applicable, paragraph 7.7.2.1. for vehicles and paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.18.2.1. for ESAs.

removed.text: When the conformity of a component, or Separate Technical Unit (STU) taken from the series is being verified, production shall be deemed to conform to the requirements of this Regulation in relation to immunity to conducted disturbances and emission if the component or STU shows no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions" up to levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1., and does not exceed the levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.

added.text: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
added.quote: After each impact test made in accordance with the conditions and procedure specified in annex 3 to this Regulation, the vehicle shall meet the following requirements: The vehicle's exhaust system shall not suffer any damage or displacement which would prevent its normal function.
added.reason: UN R42 6.1.4: post-impact criterion; siblings 6.1.1, 6.1.2, 6.1.3 and 6.1.5 are already exported.

added.text: During contact between the flexible lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
added.quote: During contact between the impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 1.11: lower-legform-to-bumper test condition; siblings 1.4/1.5/1.10/1.12 exported.

added.text: In the lower legform to bumper test, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle, with a tolerance in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane of ±2° at the time of first contact.
added.quote: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle. The tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ±2° at the time of first contact.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 1.6: impact direction of the lower-legform-to-bumper test; siblings exported.

added.text: The bottom of the flexible lower legform impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.
added.quote: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be at 75 mm above ground reference plane at the time of first contact with the bumper (see Figure 4), with a ±10 mm tolerance.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 1.7: impactor height in the lower-legform-to-bumper test; siblings exported.

added.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
added.quote: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in "free flight" at the moment of impact.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 1.8: free flight at impact in the lower-legform-to-bumper test; siblings exported.

added.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
added.quote: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal at the reference height of 445 mm.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.7.3: impactor placement for the longitudinal impact test; 2.7.1/2.7.2/2.7.5 exported.

added.text: For the longitudinal impact test, the vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
added.quote: The vehicle should be aligned so that a point between the vehicle corners touches, but does not move, the impactor, the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle being perpendicular to plane A of the impactor.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.7.4: vehicle alignment for the longitudinal impact test; 2.7.1/2.7.2/2.7.5 exported.

added.text: For the corner impact test, the impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.
added.quote: The impactor shown in the figure should be placed so that plane A is vertical and the reference line is horizontal and at the reference height of 445 mm.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.8.2: impactor placement for the corner impact test; 2.8.1/2.8.3/2.8.4 exported.

added.text: For the corner impact test, the vehicle should be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it.
added.quote: The vehicle should be aligned so that a corner of the vehicle touches the impactor without moving it. In addition the following conditions shall be met: (a) plane A of the impactor shall make an angle of 60 ± 5º with the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle; (b) the point of the first contact shall be in the vertical median plane of the impactor (within a tolerance of ± 25 mm).
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.8.3: vehicle alignment for the corner impact test; 2.8.1/2.8.3/2.8.4 exported.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
added.quote: The vehicle shall be placed on a horizontal and level rigid smooth surface.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the vehicle shall be at rest.
added.quote: The vehicle shall be at rest.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.
added.quote: The front wheels shall be in the straight-ahead position.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
added.quote: The tyres shall be inflated to the pressure recommended by the vehicle manufacturer.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the brakes shall be disengaged.
added.quote: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the low-speed-impact test, the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
added.quote: The brakes shall be disengaged and the transmission control shall be in neutral position.
added.reason: UN R42 Annex 3 2.1/2.2: vehicle condition for the low-speed impact test of the protective device.

added.text: For the upper legform to bumper tests, the selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
added.quote: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 2.4: upper-legform-to-bumper measuring points; 2.5/2.7 already exported.

added.text: In the upper legform to bumper test, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance to this direction of ±2°.
added.quote: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact. The tolerance to this direction is ±2°.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 2.6: upper-legform impact direction; 2.5/2.7 already exported.

added.text: At the time of first contact the upper legform impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
added.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 2.6: upper-legform vertical position at first contact; 2.5/2.7 already exported.

added.text: At the time of first contact the upper legform impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
added.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.
added.reason: UN R127 Annex 5 2.6: upper-legform lateral position at first contact; 2.5/2.7 already exported.

added.text: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
added.quote: The flexible lower legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 1.
added.reason: UN R127 5.1.1: the flexible lower legform impactor used for the bumper test shall be certified.

added.text: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
added.quote: The upper legform impactor shall be certified pursuant to Annex 6, paragraph 2.
added.reason: UN R127 5.1.2: the upper legform impactor used for the bumper test shall be certified.
